lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Predict: sugar in warm water vs cold (same amounts); chalk dust in water.

FEEDBACK
Sugar usually dissolves faster in warm; chalk remains mostly insoluble/visible.

WATCH FOR
Saying dissolved salt is “destroyed” is false — it can return when water evaporates.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Test five materials in water. Record soluble/insoluble and one rate note. Recover salt from saltwater by evaporation if allowed.

Write a short reflection naming one observation or step you corrected and why.
